svg.title: Channel importance estimation, top-k channel identification, partitioning, and low-rank expert routing diagram
svg.desc: Inventory and construction: f01 contains token feature columns from D, channel-wise/token-wise axes, Hadamard product, W column, and a rightward process arrow. f02 contains Top-k importance heatmap squares, ellipsis, important-channel column, and a process arrow. f03 contains an important channel frequency chart with token-independent and token-dependent channel annotations. f04 contains two outline arrows leading to dotted expert frames with hourglass low-rank adapters and expert labels. f05 contains the rounded legend. Construction uses native SVG only; no SAM image replacement is applied because no confirmed picture assets are supplied.

g.desc: Origin is the left token matrix. Content proceeds rightward: token feature blocks, ellipsis, language token column, Hadamard product, W column, and process arrow. The section is organized by channel rows and token columns.

Origin is the upper-left heatmap cell of Top-k importance. Content is distributed on a grid, with dark outlined gray cells indicating important channels, pale cells indicating unselected channels, an ellipsis, a right-side per-token column, and a process arrow. The section uses row-wise token symmetry with sparse top-k selections.

Origin is the frequency chart coordinate system. A decreasing blue frequency area occupies low channel indices, a pink token-dependent tail occupies higher indices, and dashed annotation boxes classify token-independent and token-dependent channels. The chart is asymmetric and monotone decreasing from left to right.

Origin is the upper outline arrow. Two separate rightward arrows point from the chart to vertically stacked expert boxes. The top box is shared expert with blue hourglass low-rank adapter; the lower box is routed experts with pink hourglass adapter and multiplicity by N_r. Layout uses horizontal alignment of arrow-to-box links and vertical stacking symmetry.
Legend entries proceed left to right: vision token color patches, language token color patches, Hadamard product symbol, important-channel square, and low-rank adapter hourglass.
